experiment: Minimal anti-unlearning: OVM (offline value memory) single module on IQLD online fine-tuning
change: update_iqld TD target becomes max(online target_value, frozen offline value from init checkpoint); --offline-value-memory flag, default off (no behaviour change)
conclusion: A single OVM module (max(online, frozen offline value)) clearly counteracts unlearning during online fine-tuning: C beats naive A on nominal (0.900 vs 0.890), robust (0.916 vs 0.880, +3.6pp, ties v11+guard), and nominal min-sep (0.321 vs 0.299). Remaining gap to v11+guard (0.900<0.908) is from online exploration noise + 50/50 expert mixing pulling policy toward worse online trajectories - OVM prevents forgetting but cannot fix low-quality online data; that needs balanced replay or longer training (optional later). Minimal 10-line diff, default-off, backward compatible.
